EN: Raise your season pass to the next level. Get all the benefits from the regular pass plus the following: 25 Season Badges, Cait and Zeke, a T-60f Power Armor, a Heavy Battle Armor, a Commander Uniform, 2 Pet Carriers, an Ultracite Gatling Laser, and 5,000 Caps.
ZH: 将赛季通行证提升至新高度。获得普通通行证全部权益，外加以下内容：25枚赛季徽章、凯特和泽克、T-60f动力装甲、重型战斗甲、指挥官制服、2个宠物笼子、辐射极琉矿加特林激光枪，以及5000瓶盖。

EN: Jumpstart your Vault with everything needed to get your underground life started quickly. Includes a Legendary Dweller, 2 Rare Dwellers, a Legendary Pet and a Mr. Handy. Plus Nuka-Cola Quantum and lots of Vault resources. Limit 1 per Vault.
ZH: 给您配备一切所需，来快速开始地下生活。包括一位传奇居民、两位稀有居民、一只传奇宠物和一位巧手先生，另外还有量子核子可乐和大量避难所资源。每所避难所限购1份。

EN: Sometimes these humans feel like characters in a video game. Incapable of doing anything on their own...
ZH: 有时候，这些人类感觉就像视频游戏里的角色，无法独立完成任何事情……

EN: They say there are 10 different kinds of people in the world. Those who understand binary... and those who don't.
ZH: 他们说世界上有10种人。懂二进制的和不懂二进制的。

EN: Personally, I think all this talk of an “Overseer” is so much rubbish. I've certainly never seen them.
ZH: 个人认为，关于“监督者”的所有说法都是胡说八道。我从来没有见过他们。

EN: The lighting in here is horrible. If I had eyes, they'd be ruined. Though I'd probably look dashing in horn rims...
ZH: 这里的灯光太差了。如果我有眼睛，它们早就废了。不过戴上眼镜，我可能会很帅……

EN: Of course. Send the domestic servant into a deadly post-apocalyptic Wasteland. What could possibly go wrong?
ZH: 当然。派个家务佣人去致命的末世废土。还能出什么岔子呢？

EN: Is that? Why yes, it's an old General Atomics factory. Looks like they broke the mold when they made me. Literally.
ZH: 那是？没错，那是个破败的通用原子工厂。看来他们造完我之后就把模具给砸了。这可是字面意思。

EN: You know, it's not much to look at, but an enterprising robot could make quite the life for himself out here...
ZH: 这地方看着是不怎么样，但一个有进取心的机器人在废土上也能闯出好日子来……

EN: My thermometer is reading the current temperature as something approaching “Seventh Circle of Hell”.
ZH: 我的温度计显示当前温度接近“地狱第七层”。

EN: Sensors indicate... Yes. That's a Super Mutant. And yes, I am now headed in the opposite direction...
ZH: 探测器显示……没错，那是个超级变种人。而且没错，我现在正朝反方向走……

EN: And to think, humans worried that robots would turn against them. They turned against themselves just fine...
ZH: 人类居然还担心机器人会反叛他们，他们自己的内斗都控制不住了……

EN: I think I'm getting... custodial withdrawal. I may have to enter one of these old homes and sweep up for a bit.
ZH: 我觉得我得了……清洁戒断反应。看来得进哪栋旧房子扫上一小会儿才行。

EN: A domestic robot dedicated to cleaning. Wandering a post-apocalyptic landscape. My OCD is going HAYWIRE.
ZH: 一个致力于清洁的家务机器人，在末世废土中游荡。我的强迫症要发作了。

EN: No. NO! Shoo, dog! Shoo! I am NOT a fire hydrant! I am a Mister Handy model... Agghh! No! BAD doggie!
ZH: 不。不！走开，狗狗！走开！我不是消防栓！我是巧手先生……啊！不！坏狗！

EN: This exploring is exhausting work. If I had pores, I'd be sweating like a corpulent human in a sauna.
ZH: 探索真是累人的活儿，如果我有毛孔，现在一定像桑拿房里的胖子一样汗如雨下。

EN: If I were a human, I'd be exceptionally thirsty right now. Guess that explains their Nuka-Cola obsession.
ZH: 如果我是人类，我现在一定会非常渴。看来他们对核子可乐的痴迷也不是没有原因的。

EN: I've heard rumors that a rogue A.I. actually caused the Great War. To think – WANTING a mess like this.
ZH: 我听说大战是由一个反叛的人工智能引发的。真是怪了——它怎么会想要把一切弄得这么混乱？

EN: Now would you prefer a dressing of high quality synthetic fibers, classic cotton,  or a comforting synthetic-cotton blend?
ZH: 你想要哪种绷带？优质合成纤维、经典全棉还是舒适的合成棉混纺？

EN: Who do you think would win in a fight, a lumberjack with tentacle arms, or a shark riding a unicycle?
ZH: 你觉得要是打架的话谁能赢，是长着触手手臂的伐木工？还是骑着独轮车的鲨鱼？

EN: Can you help with my crossword? Five-letter word, ends with “t.” - “Often terrible, always uncomfortable.”
ZH: 帮我解个填字游戏。三个字，“常常很糟，总是难受”。

EN: Need help with this crossword. Nine letters. Starts with “c” and ends with “d.” Means, “A horror you can never escape.”
ZH: 帮我解个填字游戏。四个字，“一场永远逃不掉的恐怖”。

EN: Well, maybe. But it depends on what they have out there. Carnivals? Street car races? Cotton candy? I mean, it would have to be worth it.
ZH: 好吧，也许吧。但这得看外面有什么。嘉年华？街头赛车？棉花糖？我是说，得值得我出去才行。

EN: I have! And the waitress says, “Keep the change? But I'm wearing denim!” Ha ha ha ha! Love that one...
ZH: 我听过！然后女服务员说：“不用找了？可我穿着牛仔服呢！”哈哈哈哈！最爱这笑话……

EN: Call the doctor! I'm having an infarction! That's a heart attack. Because you're so... Oh, never mind.
ZH: 快叫医生！我心肌梗塞了！就是心脏病发作那种。因为你实在太……哦，算了。

EN: Now would you prefer a dressing of high quality synthetic fibers, classic cotton,  or a comforting synthetic-cotton blend?
ZH: 你想要哪种绷带？优质合成纤维、经典全棉还是舒适的合成棉混纺？

EN: Share my usage data with third parties to improve marketing and show more relevant ads on third party sites.
ZH: 允许与第三方共享我的使用数据，以改进营销并在第三方网站上展示更相关的广告。

EN: If a room is full of Dwellers, the Dweller with the lowest stat for that room will swap places with the new Dweller.
ZH: 如果一个房间已满员，这个房间里相关属性最低的居民将会和新分配的居民交换位置。

EN: Drag a Dweller to the Wasteland and click on the red Vault Door button to evict them from the Vault.
ZH: 将居民拖到废土上并点击红色门按钮可以驱逐他们。

EN: Assign a Dweller to the Wasteland and select the red Vault Door button to evict them from the Vault.
ZH: 将居民派到废土上并点击红色门按钮来驱逐他们。

EN: Junk isn't as easy to find in the Wasteland as Weapons and Outfits. Make sure your Dwellers are up to the task.
ZH: 杂物不像武器和装备那样容易在废土上找到。确保您的居民适合这项工作。

EN: Dweller health does not replenish over time in a Quest... Be sure to pack tons of Stimpaks before leaving.
ZH: 居民的生命值在任务中不会自动恢复……请确保离开之前带上了足够的治疗针。

EN: I daresay these ruins would have been called a “dive bar” back before the fall. Now they're all “dive bars”!
ZH: 我得说，这些废墟在核弹落下之前，大概会被称为“破烂酒吧”。而现在，它们全都是“破烂酒吧”！

EN: Looks like a Cazador nest up ahead. They don't take much interest in those of the robotic persuasion.
ZH: 前面看起来有个卡扎多巢穴。它们对机器人这一类的家伙可没什么兴趣。

EN: Nice rifle. Totally not just slapped together with whatever they could find in New Vegas rubble. Yeah.
ZH: 好枪。绝对不单单是用新维加斯废墟里捡来的东西拼凑出来的。没错。
